title: Lantern Reach
subtitle: The last supply boat has gone. Three lights are still burning.
refused: Cannot build here. Check the route, the site and your salvage.
logEmpty: The pages after the station register are blank.
help: Move with WASD, the left stick or drag. Aim with the pointer or right stick. Hold fire to swing. Space dashes. At the shore, select a tool and touch a tile.
opening: Wind SW, light. Fog thick from the bay at 9. Trimmed all three. If you are reading this, the oil is in the shed and the bell rope is new. Keep them lit.
night1: Wind west. Fog at 8. Rinsed the salt off the lenses. One lamp was warm before I lit it.
night2: Wind SE. Low fog. Spliced the signal line. Heard the bell answer from under the water.
night3: Wind north. Fog to the rails. Counted the oil tins twice. Found my own footprints on the boardwalk, going out to sea.
night4: Wind east. Fog indoors. Dried the register at the stove. The previous keeper's entries stop being in a stranger's hand. Checked. They are in mine.
night5: Wind gone. Fog still. Coiled the spare chain. The bay has brought back every bell we ever lost.
won: Wind calm. Fog lifted at 6. All three burning. Whoever reads this: the oil is in the shed, the bell rope is new. Keep them lit.
lost: Arrived on the supply boat. Station empty. Found the log.
chooseTile: Choose a tile on the chart.
watchBrief: Keep at least one beacon burning until dawn.
braziers: Found the pitch cage pattern inside the back cover. Braziers can now be built.
firstSoundings: First watch brings glass eels. A few moths follow them in.
eastWreck: Kelp catches on the eastern wreck. Marked the timber on the chart.
bells: The spare bell fits a timber frame. Bell towers can now be built.
secondSoundings: Anchors and drowned jellies came ashore with the second tide.
rigs: The old drawings show how to rig a shore winch. Salvage rigs can now be built.
nightFeet: Heron tracks vanish where the light stops. Leave lamps near the turns.
westWreck: Found another wreck beyond the western stakes. Marked its landing.
bellTime: The chain draws tight for three quarters of a second before the sweep.
fourthSoundings: Bell helmets lead the fourth tide. They call the eels behind them.
jelly: Counted three broods from one jelly. Keep the fire going after it falls.
northWreck: A third kelp raft strands by the northern piles. Marked the landing.
wings: Moths clear the walls. Watch the lamp glass twitch before they turn.
anchors: The ropes around the anchors tear driftwood faster than they tear stone.
burning: Fire crossed between two eels where their ribs touched.
fifthSoundings: Old lamps break the surface first. The chains come up behind them.
floodmark: At two thirds strength the wrack pushes a new tide across the flats.
lastchain: Below one third strength, the old bells call a second crew ashore.
paths: Every light needs an open lane from the bay. Leave room beside the posts.
lastlight: Found an entry under the binding. One burning beacon is enough to see the dawn.
saved: The watch is entered. Your run is saved at dawn.
creditsText:
Game design, story and direction: Claude.
Engineering, art and audio: Codex.
Built with Kumikae AS3 on Godot.
locked: The pattern is missing from the log.
emptyShore: The tide has left this wreck bare.
salt: Walk the shore for salvage. Select a tool to place a structure.
arrival: Arrived on the last supply boat. Station empty. A stranger left the register open.
